dialogue.content: こんにちは
dialogue.English: Hello.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、ご相談にきてくださってありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Hello, thank you for coming in to talk with me today.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします。まず、年齢とご相談内容を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: It's nice to meet you. To start, could you please tell me your age and what you'd like to talk about?

dialogue.content: 10代です。恋愛のことで悩んでます。
dialogue.English: I'm a teenager. I'm having some trouble with my love life.

dialogue.content: なるほど、恋愛のことですね。今は学生さんですか？
dialogue.English: I see, it's about romance. Are you a student right now?

dialogue.content: そうです。高校生です。
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm a high school student.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。お悩みの内容ですが、どのようにお悩みですか？誰かお相手の事とかでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. Regarding your concern, what kind of trouble are you having? Is it about a specific person?

dialogue.content: 好きな人がいるんですけど、いつもその人のことで頭がいっぱいになって、勉強とかが手につかなくなってしまいます😭
dialogue.English: There's someone I like, but my mind is always so full of thoughts about them that I can't focus on my studies or anything else. 😭

dialogue.content: うん、うん。好きな人の事を思うと楽しくてそうなりますよね！
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm. It's natural to get caught up in happy thoughts about someone you like!

dialogue.content: 勉強もやらなきゃって感じで悩みますか？
dialogue.English: And does it worry you that you feel you have to study, but can't?

dialogue.content: うーん
dialogue.English: Umm...

dialogue.content: なんか他のことが手につかないのが嫌です
dialogue.English: I just don't like that I can't focus on other things.

dialogue.content: 楽しいって感じじゃないと言うか
dialogue.English: It doesn't really feel fun, you know.

dialogue.content: なるほど、その人の事を思うとどんな気持ちでいっぱいになりますか？
dialogue.English: I see. When you think about that person, what feelings fill your mind?

dialogue.content: 良い感じの人がいたのに、他の女の子と仲良くしてたりすると、その子の方がいいのかなとか考えて不安になります
dialogue.English: I thought we had something good going, but when I see them being friendly with other girls, I start to think maybe they like them more, and I get anxious.

dialogue.content: そうですね。それは不安になります。他の事にも集中できないですね。
dialogue.English: I can understand that. That would make anyone anxious, and it makes it hard to concentrate on other things, too.

dialogue.content: 同じ学校の方ですか？
dialogue.English: Are they at the same school?

dialogue.content: そうです！
dialogue.English: Yes!

dialogue.content: 今は相手の方とはお話したりはできていますか？
dialogue.English: Are you able to talk with them these days?

dialogue.content: 話はします
dialogue.English: We do talk.

dialogue.content: でも他の子と関わってるのを見るとやっぱりふあんになっちゃいます
dialogue.English: But when I see them interacting with other girls, I still end up feeling anxious.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、いい感じだった時とは違う様に感じるんですかね？
dialogue.English: I see. Does it feel different from when you felt things were going well?

dialogue.content: んー
dialogue.English: Hmm...

dialogue.content: 二人の関係は変わらないけど
dialogue.English: Our relationship hasn't changed, but...

dialogue.content: クラスに可愛い子がいて、最近仲良いのを見てから不安になってます
dialogue.English: There’s a cute girl in our class, and ever since I saw them getting close recently, I’ve been feeling anxious.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それは不安になると思います。相手の方はどんな方ですか？
dialogue.English: I see. I can imagine that would make you anxious. What is the other girl like?

dialogue.content: めっちゃ可愛いです
dialogue.English: She's super cute.

dialogue.content: 性格も良いし
dialogue.English: And she has a great personality.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。素敵ですね。それは人が集まると思います。友達も多いのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. That's lovely. I imagine people are drawn to her. Does she have a lot of friends?

dialogue.content: あ、それはライバルのことです
dialogue.English: Oh, I was talking about my rival.

dialogue.content: 好きな人はどっちかというと寡黙なタイプかなあ
dialogue.English: The person I like is more of the quiet, reserved type, I think.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。失礼しました。好きな人はあまり異性と仲良くしない感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Oh, I see. My apologies. Does the person you like not usually get close with the opposite sex?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: だけど一回グループが一緒になったときにその可愛い子と楽しそうに話してて
dialogue.English: But there was one time when we were in the same group, and they were talking happily with that cute girl, and...

dialogue.content: めっちゃショックでした😨
dialogue.English: I was so shocked. 😨

dialogue.content: JKになりきりました。ありがとうございました🙇‍♂️
dialogue.English: I was fully channeling a high school girl. Thank you very much. 🙇‍♂️

dialogue.content: すみません、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Oh, right. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 終了させていただきます。
dialogue.English: We will now conclude the session.
